subject: MSA + Order Form redlines — ProspectCo concerns on output & training
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@prospectco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mills <sara.mills@prospectco.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redlines: MSA + Order Form (ProspectCo / Redwood)

Hi Irene —

Attached is ProspectCo's redline of the MSA and the proposed Order Form (ProspectCo_MSA_redline_v3.docx). Key areas we flagged:

- Output ownership / productization (Section 7): we need explicit assignment for outputs generated by our data and prompts to allow downstream productization.
- Training & model improvement (Section 9): we cannot have Redwood reuse our confidential prompts/data to further train public models; if Redwood must use data, it must be under a narrow, auditable opt-in with strong safeguards.
- Feedback license (Section 11): ProspectCo wants express rights to remove or redact feedback submitted by our users.

We want to be pragmatic — happy to discuss a narrow carve-out that still allows Redwood to improve service quality while protecting our IP. Can you confirm who on your side will review and a rough timeline?

Thanks,
Alex Porter
Head of Legal Ops, ProspectCo
Attachments: ProspectCo_MSA_redline_v3.docx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@prospectco.com>
Cc: Sara Mills <sara.mills@prospectco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines: MSA + Order Form (ProspectCo / Redwood)

Alex —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear flags. We're reviewing now. Quick read / initial positions from my side:

- Output ownership: Redwood's standard position is to grant customers broad rights to use and commercialize outputs they provided input for, while Redwood retains the right to use anonymized, aggregated telemetry to operate and improve the service. ProspectCo's ask for an assignment-style clause is more than we can accept as-is; we can offer a narrowly tailored productization right tied to customer-provided prompts/data and with explicit non-exclusivity.

- Training/data use: We can support an opt-in model where ProspectCo can choose to opt into allowing Redwood to use customer data to improve models for the hosted instance, with contractual guardrails (encryption-at-rest, access controls, and a clear deletion window). We cannot broadly accept a perpetual "no-use" for operational improvements — that would materially limit our ability to run and improve the service for all customers.

- Feedback license: We are open to giving customers the ability to remove or mark feedback as restricted; we will need operational detail on how ProspectCo expects removal to propagate (e.g., immediate suppress from training pipelines, log of removed items).

I've looped in Marissa (legal) and Ben (sales) and Karthik (product/ops) to align on contract language and an operational proposal. Can we target a short call Monday to walk through a compromise? I will circulate a redline that captures our proposed compromise before the call.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Contracts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@prospectco.com>, Sara Mills <sara.mills@prospectco.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redlines: MSA + Order Form (ProspectCo / Redwood) — RWI suggested language

Irene / team —

Below are suggested edits and a short rationale. I also attached a one-page summary and a proposed clause bundle (rwi_proposed_clauses.docx) for the MSA and Order Form. High level suggestions:

1) Output rights (proposed new Section 7.2):
- "Customer retains ownership of Customer Content and of Outputs (as defined) to the extent generated by Customer Content or Customer prompts. Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Outputs solely to provide the Services to Customer and to comply with this Agreement; Redwood may not commercialize Outputs outside the Services without Customer's written consent."
Rationale: preserves customer's commercial ability while limiting Redwood from republishing outputs as product features.

2) Training (proposed new Section 9.3 — Opt-in model):
- "Redwood will not use Customer Content or Outputs to train, improve, or benchmark models used by third parties or Redwood's public models unless Customer provides explicit opt-in via the Order Form. Where Customer opts-in, Redwood shall segregate such data, maintain audit logs, and only use it in accordance with the agreed retention and deletion schedule."
Rationale: gives ProspectCo control while allowing a path for improvements when agreed.

3) Feedback license / removal workflow:
- "Customer may flag Feedback for restricted-use; upon reasonably documented request Redwood shall remove flagged Feedback from training pipelines within thirty (30) days and provide a confirmation report."
Rationale: operationally feasible and auditable.

Open items for the cross-functional call:
- Operational definition of "Outputs" (prompt-derived vs. model-generated creative edges).
- Deletion propagation guarantees and proof (what counts as confirmation).
- Whether a separate technical attestation is required (e.g., access logs, KMS events).

Next steps: Irene — pls share a single redline that merges our suggested language and ProspectCo's asks ahead of the call. Ben — can you scope commercial concessions (term discount or credits) that would make a narrow assignment-like concession feasible if required? Karthik — can you prepare a one-pager on how opt-in training would be implemented in our infra and timelines for deletion requests?

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: rwi_proposed_clauses.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@prospectco.com>, Sara Mills <sara.mills@prospectco.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines: MSA + Order Form (ProspectCo / Redwood) — proposed path forward

Alex / Sara —

Thanks for the redlines and for being specific about the concerns. We pulled together a focused proposal that we think addresses ProspectCo's commercial needs while keeping operational reality in mind. Quick summary of our offer:

1) Confirmed: Customer retains rights to Outputs created from Customer Content and prompts. We will insert the language Marissa suggested (see attached clause bundle).
2) Training opt-in: ProspectCo can opt into an "Improvement Program" on a per-Order-Form basis. Opt-in provides the limited license described; opt-in data will be tagged and stored in a segregated bucket with access logging.
3) Feedback removal: Redwood will remove flagged feedback from subsequent training pipelines within 30 days and provide a confirmation file.
4) Commercial: In exchange for the opt-in capability (and limited assignment-like clarity around Outputs), Redwood can offer a 10% credit on usage for the first 12 months under this Order Form.

Proposed next steps:
- We will circulate a merged redline (MSA+Order Form) by EOD tomorrow that incorporates the language above.
- Let's schedule a 45-minute call Wednesday to finalize the deletion workflow and confirm the opt-in checkbox wording on the Order Form.
- I'll also share a DocuSign envelope with the current Order Form for ease of iteration.

Are you available Wed 9:00–10:00 PT? If not, propose two slots and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline-summary.xlsx
